ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe contains heavy black mottling and large contiguous dark patches extending from the peduncle to the leading edge. Right lobe is predominantly white with a large black patch bordering the median notch and a small, distinct circular black spot in the distal-upper region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an acute interior angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely irregular trailing edge with high-amplitude serrations and deep, jagged excavations across both lobes, particularly prominent on the inner-to-mid section of the left lobe and the outer section of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave-to-convex transition with a sharp upward sweep ending in pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly visible clusters of small, circular, high-contrast bumps concentrated at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of distinct, parallel diagonal linear disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white field on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular tissue loss and jagged indentations along the trailing edge boundary. Multiple parallel diagonal linear rake marks visible on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, isolated, dark circular spot located in the upper-distal region of the right lobe's white field.
